The investor's designation is best described as a **restrictive covenant**. It is a use restriction on the 10-acre lot, recorded on the plan and promoted in the brochure. The 90 lot buyers, who relied on it, can enforce it under a common scheme, and the school board's 2009 vote to build there is consistent with it. My earlier answer, "offer of dedication," isn't one of the two options in the team's note, so I'm switching to the closer one, and I'm less sure of it.

CONFIDENCE: 55
